description: This file defines the Timeslot class used for representing a time segment with a label and a specific date/time, part of the Android client for Nextcloud Notes.

classes.name: Timeslot
classes.description: A class representing a specific timeslot with a label and associated date/time.

methods.name: Timeslot
methods.description: Constructor initializing a Timeslot with a label, month, and day, setting the time to the start of that day for the current year.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the timeslot.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the Calendar object representing the timeslot's date and time.
